samples.summary: Sibling block-type mutations (`toggleList`, `indent`, `outdent`) still omit `notifyStyleApplied()`, so the same stale-toolbar bug persists on those paths — and the new comment asserts the opposite
samples.evidence: The added comment at editor.ts:2807-2810 says "Same reason every sibling mutation below notifies." That is false for three siblings that also change block type/level via `doc.setBlockType`: `toggleList` ends with `invalidateLayout(); render();` at 2883-2885 with no notify, `indent` ends at 2904 with `render();` only, and `outdent` at 2925 with `render();` only. Applying a bulleted/numbered list from the toolbar (`toggleList`) changes `block.type` to 'list-item', which `getBlockType()` reports and the Text-style control derives its label from (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-style-group.tsx:79,85), yet no cursor-move callback fires, so the control keeps the previous label exactly as `setBlockType` did before this fix. The fix is therefore incomplete for the toolbar list buttons and the comment misdescribes the code around it.

samples.summary: `EditorAPI.setBlockType` snapshots without `setCursorForHistory`, unlike every other direct toolbar mutation path, so undo can restore the wrong caret/selection
samples.evidence: `setBlockType` (2802-2812) calls `docStore.snapshot()` then mutates, but never calls `docStore.setCursorForHistory(cursor.position, selection.range ?? null)`. Both `applyStyleImpl` (1007-1019) and `insertLink` (2929-2941) explicitly do so, with comments (#523) explaining that this direct toolbar path bypasses the text-editor's `saveSnapshot` hook and that without it "undo would collapse the selection". The keyboard heading path goes through `saveSnapshot` (text-editor.ts:1026) and gets the history presence; the menu path this PR is fixing does not. Pre-existing, but it lives in the exact function being changed and is the sibling-parity argument the diff comment makes.

samples.summary: Stale/incorrect factual claim in a source comment: it states the ⌘⌥N shortcut path "does not notify either", which the code (and the new test) contradict
samples.evidence: hunt-ui.mjs:313-314 asserts "the shortcut path goes through `text-editor.ts` and does not notify either, so both entry points are equally stale." In fact text-editor.ts:1035 calls `this.requestRender()`, which `editor.ts:2102` wires to `renderWithScroll`, which calls `afterCursorRender()` → `fireCursorMoveCallbacks` (editor.ts:2063-2067, 2031-2039). The shortcut path did notify before this change; only the `EditorAPI.setBlockType` menu path was stale. The comment will mislead the next reader about which paths are affected.
